items.name: tokens
items.description: Candor's tokens without its colours: the --cd-* variables, Candor's own @theme entries and the motion utilities every item's classes assume. It sets nothing a shadcn project already defines (radius, sidebar, colour roles, type scale, base styles). Every item installs it. A Candor project imports styles/candor.css and needs nothing more; with plain shadcn and your own colours, import styles/candor-tokens.css once, after Tailwind.

items.name: theme
items.description: Candor's default theme: light, dark and high contrast, contrast-checked. Import styles/candor.css after Tailwind. Roles shadcn names keep shadcn's names (--primary, --background, and --chart-1 to --chart-5, which Candor's charts read); Candor's own take the --cd- prefix (--cd-sunken, --cd-warning, --cd-chart-6).

items.name: font-inter
items.description: Inter, Candor's default typeface, self-hosted (OFL-1.1). Optional: without it the theme uses the system font. Import styles/candor-font-inter.css next to candor.css.

items.name: font-source-sans
items.description: Source Sans 3, self-hosted (OFL-1.1), as an alternative to Inter. Import styles/candor-font-source-sans.css after candor.css; it points --cd-font at it.

items.name: font-ibm-plex
items.description: IBM Plex Sans, self-hosted (OFL-1.1), as an alternative to Inter. Import styles/candor-font-ibm-plex.css after candor.css; it points --cd-font at it.

items.name: theme-slate
items.description: Slate, a gallery theme. Cool blue-grey neutrals and a blue accent; dark is a deep navy slate. Contrast-checked like the default. Import styles/candor-theme-slate.css after candor.css.

items.name: theme-paper
items.description: Paper, a gallery theme. Warm off-white grounds, blue-black ink and a terracotta accent; dark is a warm sepia. Contrast-checked like the default. Import styles/candor-theme-paper.css after candor.css.

items.name: theme-console
items.description: Console, a gallery theme. Dark-first and dense: near-black grounds, a green accent and the compact density. Light is a muted light console. Contrast-checked like the default. Import styles/candor-theme-console.css after candor.css.

items.name: theme-signal
items.description: Signal, a gallery theme. True greys with no tint and one high-saturation indigo for the action that matters. Contrast-checked like the default. Import styles/candor-theme-signal.css after candor.css.

items.name: ag-ui
items.description: Turns AG-UI events into Candor messages, waiting approvals and usage, with AG-UI 1.0's shared state and activities.

items.name: ai-sdk
items.description: Vercel AI SDK (v7) UI messages to Candor messages: text, reasoning, tool calls, sources and data cards.

items.name: claude-agent-sdk
items.description: Turns Claude Agent SDK events into Candor messages, waiting approvals (and the agent's questions), usage and sources, and a person's answer back into the SDK's result.

items.name: claude-agent-server
items.description: The server half of the Claude Agent SDK adapter: stream a run to useClaudeAgent, keep its permission requests in a store your own route can answer, and let a browser re-attach to a run after a reload.

items.name: use-ag-ui
items.description: Wires an AG-UI agent to Candor: messages for <Thread>/<Message>, props for <Composer>, and the interrupts waiting on a person.

items.name: use-candor-chat
items.description: Wires a `useChat()` result to Candor: messages for <Thread>/<Message>, props for <Composer>, and the tool calls waiting on a person.

items.name: use-claude-agent
items.description: Wires a Claude Agent SDK server route to Candor: messages for <Thread>/<Message>, props for <Composer>, and the tool calls waiting on a person, re-attaching to a run after a reload.

items.name: agent-avatar
items.description: An agent's glyph and hue by role, so people can tell agents apart at a glance.

items.name: ai-disclosure
items.description: A plain notice that the person is interacting with an AI system: a first line in the thread (`variant="line"`) or a compact "AI" badge for a thread header (`variant="badge"`) that opens to the app's own explanation.

items.name: attachment-preview
items.description: Attached files: a chip in the composer for a file waiting to be sent (name, upload progress or error, size, remove) and tiles for sent files, with an image preview when the app supplies one.

items.name: card-registry
items.description: The cards an agent's reply can carry, each with a check on its props; a card from a model renders only when its props pass.

items.name: citation
items.description: An inline [n] that opens its source in a popover, so evidence is one step away without leaving the thread.

items.name: composer
items.description: Where a person writes to the agent: @ mentions attach things as references, / starts a known action, and the scope says where the ask runs.

items.name: context-meter
items.description: What fills the model's context budget, as a ring in the composer that opens to a breakdown: system, instructions, Know, the thread, tools, files.

items.name: entity-chip
items.description: A thing in the user's system (a table, a record, a flow) as a chip with its kind's icon, that can open it.

items.name: folded-turns
items.description: A run of turns folded into one line, for long agent work a reader doesn't need to see step by step: "Drafted three versions and compared them".

items.name: message-actions
items.description: Copy, retry and rate under an agent's reply.

items.name: message-content
items.description: A message's typed blocks (paragraphs, lists, code, tool calls, cards), rendered as text, never as markdown or HTML.

breaking.change: `MessageBlock` gains two kinds: `table`, a GFM pipe table in model text, its cells inline text, and `quote`, `>` lines as inline text, one level. MessageContent draws them as a `<table>` that scrolls sideways and a `<blockquote>`, text only, never HTML. A fenced block whose language the highlighter knows is highlighted.
breaking.breaks: A `switch` over a block's `kind` that ends in a `never` check fails the type check until it handles `table` and `quote` or has a default. Model text with a pipe table, `>` lines or a fenced block in a highlighted language draws differently: as a table, a quote and highlighted code, where 6.0 drew paragraphs and plain code.
breaking.migration: Handle `table` and `quote` in a switch over a block's `kind`, or give it a default; from 6.1 a minor may add a kind, and `MessageBlock`'s doc comment says so. A model's pipe table now draws as a table, its > lines as a quote, and a fence in a language Payload highlights is highlighted in it when highlighting is on; check any CSS that matched those as paragraphs or plain code.

items.name: message
items.description: One message in a thread.

items.name: payload
items.description: A block of code or query text from the agent: a query it ran, code it wrote, a config file.

items.name: permission-prompt
items.description: A tool call an agent asks to make, waiting for a person to approve or deny it before it runs: what it will do, why it reached them, and the permission mode the run is in.

items.name: prompt-suggestions
items.description: Prompts to start from.

items.name: reasoning
items.description: The agent's stated reasoning above its answer.

items.name: thread-divider
items.description: A rule across the thread with a label in the middle: a day ("Today", "Yesterday", "5 Nov 2026") or a chapter of the conversation ("Drafting", "Review").

items.name: thread-event
items.description: A quiet, centred line in a thread for something that happened rather than something said: "Sam joined", "Switched to the staging environment", "Run stopped by a guardrail".

items.name: thread
items.description: The scrolling message column.

items.name: tool-call
items.description: One tool call as a compact row: what it did in plain words, its status, and how long it took.

items.name: bidi
items.description: Text from a model or a tool, safe to show: each bidi control character (U+202A to U+202E, U+2066 to U+2069) is replaced by a visible mark naming it, such as `[U+202E]`.

items.name: chat
items.description: The data a Candor thread renders.

items.name: fill-strings
items.description: A message's forms chosen by a word: `vars[select]` when it names a case, else the `gender` of the noun called `select`, else `other`.

items.name: format-elapsed
items.description: A measured span of time in the locale: "4.2s" under ten seconds, "42s" under a minute, then "2m 5s".

items.name: heading-level
items.description: A heading's level in the page's outline: `1` is `<h1>`, `6` is `<h6>`.

items.name: heading-scope
items.description: Says the content inside sits under a heading of `level`, so each Candor item in it draws its heading one level below (`level + 1`) unless it is given `headingLevel`.

items.name: highlight
items.description: A small syntax highlighter for code an agent shows: it splits text into typed tokens (keyword, string, comment…), and Payload renders each as a span.

items.name: know
items.description: The data behind the agents' knowledge base and agent settings.

items.name: layer
items.description: How Candor's portalled layers (dialogs, sheets, popovers, menus, selects, tooltips) stay usable inside an app built on another primitive library.

items.name: locale
items.description: The interface's words, language and direction.

items.name: mcp-input
items.description: MCP's "input required" results (spec 2026-07-28, multi round-trip requests) as Candor data: a server's form becomes questions for ClarifyingQuestions, a plain confirmation or a link to open becomes a two-answer Decision for DecisionCard, and the person's answers become the `inputResponses` the client sends when it retries the call.

items.name: motion
items.description: Candor's motion layer: fourteen families, one per kind of change, each tunable by a brand file, and the hooks that decide when a change has settled or arrived; a theme tunes how a change looks, never when it happens.

items.name: safe-markdown
items.description: Reads model text as safe markdown: paragraphs, lists, fenced code, pipe tables and quotes, never HTML.

items.name: sound
items.description: The names and the reading half of Candor's sound layer.

items.name: status
items.description: The status vocabulary every Candor agent component shares.

items.name: use-copy
items.description: Copy text and report what actually happened.

items.name: use-shortcut
items.description: Run `handler` when a key combo is pressed anywhere on the page: "mod+k", "mod+shift+o", "?", "escape".

items.name: use-virtual-list
items.description: Render only the items of a long list that are in or near view, for Thread's and SessionList's `virtualize`.

items.name: copy-field
items.description: A value a person copies somewhere else (a callback URL, a scope list).

items.name: degraded-panel
items.description: A degraded result: what went wrong, what is missing because of it, and a retry only when the caller can actually retry.

items.name: relative-time
items.description: A time as people say it ("5 minutes ago"), with the exact time on hover, safe to render on the server.

items.name: status-dot
items.description: A small status mark.

items.name: step-list
items.description: A run's steps with their status, each mark drawn still on mount and animated only when the status changes on screen.

items.name: streaming-text
items.description: Text that is still arriving.

items.name: surface
items.description: Candor's card: a plain, muted, bordered or floating surface, so no screen hand-rolls its own.

items.name: page-header
items.description: The top of every page that isn't a thread: where you are (breadcrumb), what the page is, what you can do here (actions), and its views (tabs).

items.name: page-state
items.description: What a page shows instead of its content: nothing here yet (empty), nothing matches the filters (no-match), something broke (error), it can't be shown to you (unavailable), or the service can't be reached from here (offline).

items.name: accordion
items.description: A stack of headings that each open to reveal more.

items.name: alert
items.description: A message about the page or the work that stays where it is until it no longer applies: a warning before a change, a note that something failed, a fact the person should know.

items.name: button
items.description: shadcn's button in Candor's theme, with a locked state for <Locked> (dimmed, and says why).

items.name: checkbox
items.description: A box the person ticks.

items.name: collapsible
items.description: shadcn's collapsible (Base UI) in Candor's theme.

items.name: label
items.description: The name of a control.

items.name: locked
items.description: The honest-state rule: a control that cannot be used says why.

items.name: popover
items.description: shadcn's popover (Base UI) in Candor's theme.

items.name: progress
items.description: A bar for work whose progress is measured: an upload, an import, an index.

items.name: skeleton
items.description: A loading placeholder in the shape of what's coming.

items.name: slider
items.description: A control for a value in a range, with one thumb or, when the value has two numbers, a range.

items.name: switch
items.description: A setting that is on or off.

items.name: tooltip
items.description: shadcn's tooltip (Base UI) in Candor's theme.
